## Details

<a id="shadow_facing0"></a>
### [`shadow_facing0`](../../../../src/graphics/shadow_sprites_d480.asm#L6) `$D480-$D6FF`

*data*

Floor shadow blocks for facing 0, shown directly as VIC pointers in the 4th sprite row. Tables $3b65/$3b75/$3b85 give the pointers for the 8 air frames at $3b5d (10, 58, 9, 32, 21, 23, 22, 20).
Pointers $52-$5b: shadows of frames 32, 21, 23, 22 and 20 (v1 $d540-$d77f).

<a id="judge_sprite_scene01"></a>
### [`judge_sprite_scene01`](../../../../src/graphics/shadow_sprites_d480.asm#L222) `$D700-$D73F`

*data*

Judge sprite for scenes 0 and 1 (pointer $5c): a smaller figure in the lower half of the block. judge_show_winner puts the flag 2 pixels left and 6 lines down for it ($1fc9). New in v2.

<a id="shadow_facing0_b"></a>
### [`shadow_facing0_b`](../../../../src/graphics/shadow_sprites_d480.asm#L245) `$D740-$D87F`

*data*

Pointers $5d-$61: shadows of frames 10 and 58 ($5d-$5f) and frame 9 ($60-$61), facing 0 (v1 $d8c0-$d9ff).

<a id="shadow_facing1"></a>
### [`shadow_facing1`](../../../../src/graphics/shadow_sprites_d480.asm#L354) `$D880-$DBFF`

*data*

Floor shadow blocks for facing 1, pointers $62-$70 (v1 $db40-$deff). Each block is the mirror image (table $7e00) of a facing 0 shadow block.
